text:
Nadia: follow-up from the pool orchestration sync: i'm proposing a tiny 'grant-proxy' service to centralize short-lived burst grants so operators don't need heavy cross-talk. goals: predictable 429s to clients, signed fast-tokens, and clear reconciliation. thoughts?

Omar: sounds good. two clarifications: does proxy own accounting (cost/burn) or just issue tokens?

Nadia: proxy will maintain token-buckets + simple budget counters (per-tenant daily cap). billing will read proxy's events for attribution.

Bea: operator-side: how do we validate fast-tokens without hitting proxy? prefer signed tokens (HMAC) with nonce window to avoid network roundtrips.

Riley: agreed. sketch token payload: `tenant, grant_id, ttl, tokens, sig, nonce`. operator keeps small in-memory nonce set for TTL.

Nadia: operator modes: advisory (default) => use tokens to prewarm but never evict; reserve => refuse non-reserved admits to honor headroom; strict => evict low-priority to satisfy grant. make per-tenant + per-pool config.

Omar: add metrics: grant_issued, grant_denied, grant_revoked, operator_grant_apply, operator_grant_conflict, grant_drift_seconds. critical for SLOs.

Bea: add backpressure: proxy returns 429 when queueing would exceed a small window, and clients should receive Retry-After.

deploy-bot: preview: grant-proxy:v0.1 -> staging-shard-1 :rocket:

Nadia: rollout plan: FF behind advisory mode, canary a single shard, then enable reserve for beta tenants. i'll draft short RFC + SE note on choosing modes. thanks for quick feedback.
